lcc_original: 只是那能使人分別善惡【6】的知識樹的果子，你卻不可喫；因爲你喫的日子、你一定死。』
notes: H01847 (דַּעַת/knowledge) attached to 知識 rather than 分別: LCC expands the Hebrew construct עֵץ הַדַּעַת into '知識樹' plus an explanatory relative clause '能使人分別善惡'; 知識 is the direct rendering of H01847 while 分別 is part of the added gloss and receives no SN.
善 (H02896) and 惡 (H07451) appear before 知識 in LCC's paraphrase word order; SNs placed immediately after each word at their natural positions.
Both {<WAH04480>} implicit markers (מִמֶּנּוּ = from it) retained as implicit: LCC has no explicit pronoun or particle corresponding to either instance.
UNV 必定 → LCC 一定: H04191+WTH8800 (infinitive absolute מוֹת, the 'surely' intensifier) transferred to 一定; 死 retains H04191+WTH8799 (main verb תָּמוּת).
